title: mcp.json present as a directory invalidates MCP and leaves skills loading
rationale: The mirror image of the skills-as-a-file case, and the one clients usually miss.
quote: If a fixed component location is present but does not resolve to the expected filesystem kind — for example, `skills` does not resolve to a directory or `mcp.json` does not resolve to a regular file — the client MUST treat that component type as invalid and continue loading other supported component types.
